@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Mom is very good at giving m______es. Whenever I have a backache, I ask her to give me a back rub.
= massages
~詞義 massage（n.）按摩
~原文 Mom is very good at giving massages. Whenever I have a backache, I ask her to give me a back rub.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The mayor's opponent tried hard to u______e his reputation by spreading rumors.
= undermine
~詞義 undermine（v.）逐漸損害
~原文 The mayor's opponent tried hard to undermine his reputation by spreading rumors.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Henry found five thousand dollars on the MRT, and he handed the money in to the police. What he did was very h______e.
= honorable
~詞義 honorable（adj.）值得尊敬的
~原文 Henry found five thousand dollars on the MRT, and he handed the money in to the police. What he did was very honorable.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The agent b______yed his country by selling a lot of secret information to a rival country.
= betrayed
~詞義 betray（v.）背叛
~原文 The agent betrayed his country by selling a lot of secret information to a rival country.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: I enjoy s______rs more than lectures because I can have more opportunities to express my opinions and learn from other students.
= seminars
~詞義 seminar（n.）研討會
~原文 I enjoy seminars more than lectures because I can have more opportunities to express my opinions and learn from other students.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The ______ meeting is held every Monday. The teaching staff report what they did during the previous week and what they plan to do over the current week.
A: activist
B: deficit
C: faculty
D: subsidy
= C
~詞義 faculty（n.）全體教職員
~原文 The faculty meeting is held every Monday. The teaching staff report what they did during the previous week and what they plan to do over the current week.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The witness's ______ helped the jury understand exactly what happened during the chaotic incident.
A: acquisition
B: testimony
C: mechanism
D: pessimism
= B
~詞義 testimony（n.）證詞
~原文 The witness's testimony helped the jury understand exactly what happened during the chaotic incident.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: This factory is going to gradually ______ out older devices as newer models become available.
A: uncover
B: delegate
C: phase
D: scramble
= C
~詞義 phase（v.）分階段淘汰
~原文 This factory is going to gradually phase out older devices as newer models become available.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The company ______ its outdated policy and replaced it with a more efficient approach.
A: defied
B: scrapped
C: tangled
D: undid
= B
~詞義 scrap（v.）廢除
~原文 The company scrapped its outdated policy and replaced it with a more efficient approach.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Many men experience hair loss in middle age. This is because of changes in their ______.
A: chunks
B: hormones
C: petitions
D: sheriffs
= B
~詞義 hormone（n.）荷爾蒙
~原文 Many men experience hair loss in middle age. This is because of changes in their hormones.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: unemployment
B: clarity
C: civic
D: meantime
E: scrambled
F: theology

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: Tommy's composition showed ______ of thought and great persuasive skills.
= B
~詞義 clarity（n.）(思路)清晰
~原文 Tommy's composition showed clarity of thought and great persuasive skills.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The video showed that the burglar had ______ over the wall and sneaked into the house.
= E
~詞義 scramble（v.）攀爬
~原文 The video showed that the burglar had scrambled over the wall and sneaked into the house.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: The ______ rate is getting higher, and the government is trying to help people get jobs.
= A
~詞義 unemployment（n.）失業
~原文 The unemployment rate is getting higher, and the government is trying to help people get jobs.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: Alex believes that it is his ______ responsibility to take part in community service.
= C
~詞義 civic（adj.）公民的
~原文 Alex believes that it is his civic responsibility to take part in community service.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The laptop that I ordered online will arrive next week. In the ______, I am using my father's.
= D
~詞義 meantime（n.）(與此)同時
~原文 The laptop that I ordered online will arrive next week. In the meantime, I am using my father's.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: acute
B: solo
C: photographic
D: delegate
E: expedition
F: petty

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: Mary had a(n) ______ headache, so she took half a day off and went to see a doctor.
= A
~詞義 acute（adj.）嚴重的
~原文 Mary had a(n) acute headache, so she took half a day off and went to see a doctor.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: Charles was chosen as the class representative, so he will be their ______ to attend meetings about student affairs.
= D
~詞義 delegate（n.）代表
~原文 Charles was chosen as the class representative, so he will be their delegate to attend meetings about student affairs.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: We asked our friend Sam to take our wedding pictures because he has great ______ skills.
= C
~詞義 photographic（adj.）攝影的
~原文 We asked our friend Sam to take our wedding pictures because he has great photographic skills.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: To gain independence and confidence, Joanna planned to travel ______ for three months next year.
= B
~詞義 solo（adv.）單獨地
~原文 To gain independence and confidence, Joanna planned to travel solo for three months next year.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: NASA sent a rocket on a(n) ______ to Mars to investigate the possibility of existing life forms there.
= E
~詞義 expedition（n.）探險隊
~原文 NASA sent a rocket on a(n) expedition to Mars to investigate the possibility of existing life forms there.
